critique.evidence: The dark grid, restrained cyan/green accents, monospaced metadata, bold headline, and bordered precedent panel create a cohesive defense-lab aesthetic. The mobile card hierarchy is especially clear. However, desktop and tablet are visibly under-polished: the navigation rail bisects the hero, obscures the oversized headline and results explanation, and clips overflowing navigation labels. Tablet content beneath the rail becomes nearly illegible. The desktop headline also dominates the composition while the explanatory artifact is stranded at right, weakening balance. Small uppercase labels and muted secondary text are low-contrast at narrower sizes.
critique.fix: Give the header its own non-overlapping vertical space and collapse it into a deliberate compact/mobile navigation before labels overflow. Reflow the results artifact below the hero copy on tablet, reduce the desktop headline scale, and slightly increase the size/contrast of tiny metadata. Preserve the strong mobile card treatment while aligning row content and similarity values consistently across breakpoints.
